'''Jason Foss Star Destroyers will Dominate''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Jason Foss]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-10642">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/10642 Star Destroyers will Dominate], DeckTech (Jason "jade" Foss, 24 September 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/10642/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/10642/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018114248/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/10642/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Jason Foss]]
* '''Published:''' 24 September 2000 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''Star Destroyers will Dominate''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|TA-D-setyourcourseforalderaan.gif|label=Set Your Course For Alderaan}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Prepared Defenses|DS2-D-prepareddefenses.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PDS2 SYCFA Foss DS 2000 10642.txt |Download]]
* '''Strategy:''' Fun deck that uses SYCFA to get lot's of force and then dominates space.

== Original post ==

'''Star Destroyers will Dominate'''
* '''Author:''' Jason "jade" Foss
* '''Published:''' September 24, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' Fun deck that uses SYCFA to get lot's of force and then dominates space.

=== Strategy ===

This Deck is fun to play. Get sombody to the docking bay fast to star activating force i like to put commander merrejk there so he can start pulling systems from my deck there 2 in here so don't worry about losing one.Against any kind of space deck you can just overpower them and against grond decks just out drain them.I don't have The deathstar war room in here cause it was the 61 card and i figured that i had enouph activation already plus they drain for 2 there so I took it out.Plaes on't just say it sucks tell me what to tak ou and what to put in.
